Name: Retaining Soil Level Up
Author: Furuchooo
Description:
Just an option to craft weaker retaining soil into better ones

You can convert Basic Retaining Soil into Quality Retaining Soil and Quality Retaining Soil into Deluxe Retaining Soil.

The conversion is 4 to 1

You learn Basic to Quality at Level 6 Farming and Quality to Deluxe at level 9
